result.summary: Implemented the validated design (schema-qualified both repository_artifacts INSERTs to public.repository_artifacts) AND expanded scope during implementation after empirical testing revealed the design's fix, while necessary, was insufficient on its own. tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig's fixture writes (insertQuotaPolicyArtifact, ensureQuotaPolicyActivation, provisionTenant) all ran on harness.conn, whose BEGIN...ROLLBACK transaction (per TestHarness.init/deinit) is never committed and therefore invisible to the separate pool.acquire() connections that quota_policy.loadEffectiveQuotaProfile and quota_middleware.check actually read through -- an entirely separate, pre-existing bug matching the documented ISS-0144/GH-454 class (see insertTenantViaPool in svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig). Added local pool-based fixture helpers (insertQuotaPolicyArtifact, ensureQuotaPolicyActivation, provisionTenantViaPool, execViaPool) following that exact precedent, and rewired the artifact/activation/tenant fixture writes (all of which have public-schema-reachable canonical homes) through them. Also wired exp601_tier_quota_test.zig into build.zig for the first time ever (confirmed absent from every build target previously -- ISS-0617's own diagnosis had to use a temporary, reverted build step to run it at all) via a new test-integration-exp601 step, permanently closing that CI-invisibility gap. Fixed an unrelated pre-existing memory leak in TC-EXP-601-03 (missing free of quota_middleware.check's rejected-path response body -- unreachable before this fix since the test never got far enough to hit the rejected branch). RESULT: TC-EXP-601-01, 03, 05 now PASS (repository_artifacts/config-resolution root cause fully fixed, matching ISS-0617's actual stated scope). TC-EXP-601-02 and 04 still FAIL, but for two SEPARATE, PRE-EXISTING reasons, neither a regression from this work: (1) TC-EXP-601-02 and the first half of TC-EXP-601-04 fail because quota_enforcement.zig's readUsageForDimension reads instance_projections/instance_waits/dead_letter_items -- genuine PER_TENANT tables with NO public copy -- unqualified via pool, which under .LEGACY_RLS storage_mode (the default for any tenant, confirmed at src/db/pool.zig) sets search_path=public only, making these tables structurally unreachable; this is a production-path defect affecting every LEGACY_RLS tenant, filed as ISS-0622/GH-576 (BLOCKER) and added to the global queue for its own future WF-03 run. (2) TC-EXP-601-04's instance_waits fixture INSERT itself errors (PgError.ServerError) -- this is the SAME issue ISS-0617 itself already flagged as a second, distinct, out-of-scope failure mode (see ISS-0617.json test_blocks_relationship field), not something this run introduced or was asked to fix. GBL-136 ships unmodified per the design's recommendation.
